stories.title: Massive 70lb Dog the Size of Baby Hippo Sheds Pounds and Gets New Home
stories.label: animals
stories.summary: A bulldog named Peggy Sue had grown so overweight she could barely walk, tipping the scales at 70 pounds, which is about the size of a baby hippo. Caring staff at the RSPCA's West Hatch Animal Centre in England took her in and helped her lose the extra weight through a gentle, steady recovery plan. Now healthier and much more mobile, Peggy Sue has found a loving new home where she can enjoy life as a normal-sized, happy dog. It's a sweet reminder of what patience and kindness can do for an animal in need.
stories.why_good: A real rescue animal genuinely recovered her health and was adopted into a loving home, with no suffering or loss at its core, just a feel-good happy ending that already happened.
